verdict.rationale: Git stash and unstash is a fair axis for a Unix-like terminal app, since such a terminal could bundle git, so the verdict is not 'na'. The evidence pack never mentions git, stash, or any version-control commands, only languages, pkg-installed WebAssembly commands, and file and folder access. With no documented capability, the verdict is 'none'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory
